task_input: Harden managed worktree discovery for linked Git checkouts. `git worktree list --porcelain` is common-dir-wide, but the configured relative worktree root must be resolved from every registered checkout, not only the invoking checkout. Add a pure resolver for the managed-root set and let porcelain parsing recognize a detached pipeline worktree below any of those roots. Preserve the single-root API behavior and add focused tests.

implementing.plan: Derive the de-duplicated managed roots from porcelain worktree records, accept either a legacy single root or the derived root set in porcelain parsing, classify detached pipeline worktrees below any managed root, and add linked-checkout regression coverage.

hidden_checks: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { parseWorktreePorcelain, resolveManagedRoots } from './core/scripts/worktree.ts'; const porcelain=['worktree /repo/main','HEAD 1','branch refs/heads/main','','worktree /repo/linked','HEAD 2','branch refs/heads/feature','','worktree /repo/linked/.worktrees/pipeline-42-linked','HEAD 3','detached',''].join('\n'); const roots=resolveManagedRoots(porcelain,'.worktrees'); assert.deepEqual(roots.sort(),['/repo/linked/.worktrees','/repo/main/.worktrees']); const records=parseWorktreePorcelain(porcelain,roots); assert.ok(records.some(r=>r.issueNumber===42&&r.slug==='linked'&&r.underManagedRoot===true));"

acceptance_criteria.statement: A detached pipeline worktree under a linked checkout's configured root is discovered as managed.
